name: @pie527645-cloud/shutdown-guard
description: Static TypeScript/JavaScript AST verifier for HTTP graceful shutdown signal handlers, drain paths, and keep-alive timeout ordering.
author: pie527645-cloud

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/normalize-lf.mjs
scripts.test: node --test dist-test/test/rules.test.js dist-test/test/golden.test.js dist-test/test/formatters.test.js dist-test/test/pathGuard.test.js dist-test/test/cli.test.js
